thread:
maria: APAC L4 cluster showing tail latency spike since ~09:12 UTC. KV cache hit-rate fell ~18% right after the runtime merge. Dash: https://dash.redwood/cluster/apac-l4/latency

sre-bot: alert: high_p99_latency on apac-l4 - 2026-06-18T09:14

jon: I spun up a quick perf trace on canary hosts. Seeing queuing on the recv/send queues and a lot of TCP retransmits on a subset of L4 nodes. Not everywhere.

lee: Is this looking like noisy neighbor or something our runtime change did?

jon: Bisect points strongly to commit abc1234 (runtime: reorder kernel-selection fallback). Reproducible on a local L4 canary with production traffic replay.

ananya: Any NIC/driver counters? Can you paste ethtool / netstat snippets?

jon: quick snippet from apac-l4-022:
```
# ethtool -S eth0 | egrep "tx_dropped|rx_errors|tcp_retrans_segs"
rx_errors: 0
tx_dropped: 1243
tcp_retrans_segs: 2137
```

jon: netstat -s also shows retransmits up 3x and some socket backlog drops.

net-team: We correlate host list -> impacted nodes are running mlx-driver v2.4.1. Looks like the kernel fallback reorder causes different user-space batching pattern (we use sendmmsg) that increases small-packet burstiness. Some L4 NICs/firmware combos drop during bursts.

maria: That would explain KV cache churn: higher RTT -> more timeouts -> more evictions -> hit-rate down -> more load. Which hardware variants are unaffected?

jon: A10 variants mostly unaffected in APAC. H100 clusters show normal behavior. It's specific to the L4 fleet with that driver.

lee: Can we mitigate in runtime quickly? e.g., cap sendmmsg batch size when we detect driver v2.4.x or on L4 hosts?

ananya: I ran a local patch that caps batch size to 8 (was 32) and replayed the workload. p99 returned to baseline on the canary. KV hit-rate rebounded.

deploy-bot: started revert of commit abc1234 on apac-l4 canary (actioned by @jon)

sre-bot: revert completed on canary at 09:40 UTC. Monitoring.

maria: Canary metrics look good — p99 down to normal, KV hit-rate back up. Good quick rollback. :thumbsup:

jon: I'll open a proper fix PR: conditional batch caps for known driver/firmware combos + telemetry for retransmit surges. PR: https://git.redwood/runtime/pull/5421

lee: Plan: hold full rollout until PR merged and vendor firmware triaged. Also schedule a canary with batch-cap patch plus a driver bump on two L4 hosts.

net-team: We'll open vendor ticket and collect NIC stats for all affected hosts.

ananya: Adding a blocker on rollout board: "APAC L4 driver + batching --> rollback required". Will attach traces.

maria: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread for the postmortem and mitigation notes. If anyone has more logs, drop them here. :eyes:
